name: webengine
about: The rendering and script engine the OS browser uses for full page rendering. This recipe is the integration point: installing it upgrades NovaBrowser from a structured document reader to a full visual browser.

integrationPoint.note: NovaBrowser implements transport, HTML parsing, navigation and downloads itself. A rendering engine supplies layout, painting and a script runtime. When this package is installed, NovaBrowser renders the parsed document through the engine instead of showing it as text.
contract: render(html: string, url: string, viewport: { width: number; height: number }): { pixels: Uint8Array; links: { href: string; rect: number[] }[] }
runScripts: boolean, executed in the engine's own sandbox
The engine must not be granted access to the OS bus or the filesystem.

files.text: Place the rendering engine's shared objects and resources here. The OS loads it by path, never by installing anything system-wide.
